subject: int
title: (R)INT.------WO.EXP.PRI.
description: Diagram opening MP(II)-33 — the section on the energy-environment dilemma as the ecological implication of political functionalism. The prose below identifies the structural target: 'the ecological implications of political functionalism must be viewed as directly related to the coming dilemma we are leaving our children to face... "What is happening to our air?" — "What is happening to the beautiful rivers and lakes of this planet?" — "What will become of this planet unless serious changes are made?"' The crossing diagrams how the reality of intention structurally meets world-expansion-principle at the energy/environmental scale: (R)INT (the reality of intention — actual intentional working in the political-functional system) crossed with WO-EXP-PRI (world expansion principle). INT sits on the right with the subject-arrow; POL-DY (political dynamics) drops diagonally from the main line beside it, with RT-OP (reality options) branching up-right from POL-DY and CULT-INFO (cultural information) branching down from it. AF-DY (affinity dynamics) branches from CULT-INFO, and S-ST (source shift (progressionalism) manipulation) and MT-INTR (multiple interpretation) branch from AF-DY. WO-EXP-PRI sits at upper-left as partner-axis. PART (participation) and TRS (transition) drop from the main line; POST (postulation) branches from PART, PROJ-DY (projectional dynamics) from POST, and STY (style) from PROJ-DY.
